name: Editorial / Paper Collage
summary: Hand-assembled layered paper: cut-out figures, torn edges, halftone dots and heavy type on a kraft-cream ground. Tactile, playful and graphic; motion behaves like paper being placed and slid, not like software.

identity.visual_language: layered cut-outs with hard paper shadows, tape and halftone
identity.editorial_approach: each scene is a poster assembled in front of the viewer
identity.illustration_style: printed or woodcut cut-out figures, flat ink colour
identity.photography_style: halftoned or duotoned photographs cut to silhouette
identity.composition_philosophy: one dominant cut-out, 2-3 supporting scraps, text on a banner of its own paper
identity.environment: flat kraft or coloured card ground, never a gradient
identity.storytelling_conventions: objects arrive by being placed; reveals by sliding one sheet off another

palette.contrast_strategy: dark ink on warm paper; accent only on large display type and shapes

typography.display: Archivo Black, sentence or all caps, tight tracking
typography.scale_and_hierarchy: one huge headline word per beat, small captions on tape labels

composition.principles: asymmetric stack with overlap and rotation of 1-4 degrees; large occupancy
composition.negative_space: minimal; paper texture fills quiet areas

design_system.shape_language: torn and scissor-cut polygons, circles for stickers
design_system.lighting: flat, with a consistent top-left paper shadow
design_system.visual_rhythm: alternate full-bleed collages with typographic beats
design_system.image_treatment: halftone or duotone; no soft photographic gradients

motion.grammar: Things are placed, slid and flipped like paper on a table. Movement is slightly stepped and tactile; overshoot is small and rare.

easing.entrances: settle-lean for hero scraps, enter-decel for the rest

timing.pace: medium-fast; a new picture every 2-3 s
timing.holds: short; keep drift on the held sheet

transitions.continuity: a shape or colour carries the eye across the cut

camera.language: flat-safe: uniform push, pull and parallax between sheets; no perspective warp of text

motion.object_movement: small bobs and drifts on cut-outs, assembling pieces
motion.stillness_policy: A held collage keeps one living scrap (drift or flutter).

audio_direction.music: light acoustic or jazzy bed, low
audio_direction.sfx: paper rustle, tape, stamp thuds at 12-18 dB under voice

rendering.strategy: Programmatic SVG/CSS collage in HyperFrames; photographic cut-outs from generated or licensed stills with a paper-edge filter; halftone and grain procedural.
rendering.resource_notes: Light; the deckle filter is the heaviest element.

provenance.method: Authored rule set (prescribed). Derived from the style system's tokens, the workspace motion vocabulary and the technique records listed; not extracted from a single reference.
provenance.notes: Every value here is prescribed intent, not a measurement. Evidence of use is recorded under 'validation' only after a render exists.

weaknesses: Paper imitation reads as cheap if shadows and rotation are inconsistent.
Generated cut-out figures can carry hallucinated detail; check each one.
Collage plus dense data fights for attention.
example_scenes: A single cut-out figure over a map with a taped headline banner; the banner slides off to reveal the next sheet.
